base.name: Hermes Agent
base.text: The Atum app (Resources/app.asar) and the Atum agent (Resources/runtime/hermes-agent) are built from Hermes Agent, with Atum's changes.

includes.name: Block Buzz channel sidebar UI adapted for Atum Team Space
notes: Atum adapts ResizableSidebar, ResizeHandle, SidebarFrame, SidebarList, SidebarSection, ChannelSidebarRow, FadingLabel, AppShell page placement, PageNavigation and Tabs focus behavior to Atum primitives, tokens and Matrix/company authority. The preserved upstream NOTICE records the earlier Astra channel-layout lineage.

includes.name: gstack browser cookie importer adapted for Atum browser import
notes: Atum adapts browse/src/cookie-import-browser.ts (Chrome profile discovery, the Keychain Safe Storage key, PBKDF2 and AES-128-CBC cookie decryption, the Chromium epoch and SameSite mapping) and the cookie rows and key of browse/test/cookie-import-browser.test.ts into apps/desktop/electron/matrix/browser-import, replacing Bun SQLite and process calls with Electron Node (node:sqlite and execFile). Copyright (c) 2026 Garry Tan.

includes.name: Simple Icons provider marks bundled in the Atum model picker
notes: Atum bundles the Claude, DeepSeek, OpenCode, Google Gemini, MiniMax, Qwen and GitHub Copilot vector paths. Individual brand and trademark rights are not waived by the Simple Icons CC0 distribution; the marks appear only beside their named providers. MiniMax carries the custom permission recorded by Simple Icons, and GitHub Copilot is individually recorded as MIT in the pinned catalog.

includes.name: Lobe Icons OpenAI and Grok provider marks bundled in the Atum model picker
notes: Atum bundles the OpenAI and Grok vector paths as small provider identifiers. OpenAI's mark remains subject to https://openai.com/brand and is used only for directly related ChatGPT/OpenAI routes; no endorsement is implied.

includes.name: Be Vietnam Pro font bundled for reviewed Atum look packs
copyright: Copyright 2021 The Be Vietnam Pro Project Authors
notes: Atum bundles upstream Regular, Medium and SemiBold WOFF2 files. Exact source URLs, byte counts and SHA-256 values are recorded in apps/desktop/src/fonts/look-pack-fonts.json.

includes.name: Literata font bundled for reviewed Atum look packs
notes: Atum bundles upstream Regular and SemiBold WOFF2 files. Exact source URLs, byte counts and SHA-256 values are recorded in apps/desktop/src/fonts/look-pack-fonts.json.

components.name: GBrain (local-brain/bin/gbrain and local-brain/src)
notes: local-brain/bin/gbrain is GBrain's own release binary, compiled by its authors with Bun 1.4.2 (bun build --compile). It therefore contains the Bun runtime and the libraries Bun links statically, listed below.

components.name: Bun
components.license: MIT, with the licences of the libraries it links statically (listed in its licence file)

components.name: JavaScriptCore and WebKit, in Bun's fork
components.license: LGPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL-2.1-or-later (per file), and BSD-style licences
notes: Bun links JavaScriptCore statically, so the gbrain binary contains it. To use a modified JavaScriptCore: build Bun 1.4.2 from its source with your WebKit (Bun's licence file above gives the steps), build GBrain from its source at the commit above with that Bun (bun build --compile), sign the result ad hoc (codesign --force --sign - <file>) and put it at local-brain/bin/gbrain. Atum runs that binary only if its size and SHA-256 match the "signed" entry of local-brain/SIGNED-BINARY.json, so record the new size and SHA-256 there, then re-sign Atum ad hoc (codesign --force --deep --sign - <path of the Atum app>).

components.name: PGlite, embedded in the gbrain binary
notes: PGlite includes PostgreSQL, under the PostgreSQL licence.
